data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Aikaterine, which means 'pure, clean'. In Christianity, Katarzyna is the Polish name for Saint Catherine, who was known for her purity and strong faith. The name Katarzyna carries the meaning “Pure, Clean” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Katarzyna usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of spiritual purity and faith.
data.etymology: Katarzyna belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Katarzyna total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: קטרזינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קטרזינה מקורו בשם העברי קתרינה, שפירושו טוהר וצדק במשיח. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית קאθארίνη (Katharina), שפירושו טהור. השם קטרזינה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו במסורת היוונית והלטינית, ומשמעותו רוחנית וקשורה לטוהר ולצדק במשיח.

in_greek.name: Καταρζίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καταρζίνα προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Καθαρίνη (Katharina), που σημαίνει καθαρή και δίκαιη. Το όνομα αυτό έχει τις ρίζες του στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας και συνδέεται με την έννοια της καθαρότητας και της δικαιοσύνης στον Χριστό. Στην ιστορία της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Καταρζίνα έχει συσχετιστεί με πολλές αγίες και μάρτυρες.

in_latin.name: Katarzyna
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Katarzyna originem habet in traditione christiana, derivatum ex nomine Graeco Καθαρίνη (Katharina), quod significat munditiam et justitiam. Nomen hoc est symbolum puritatis et rectitudinis in Christo, et habet magnam significationem spiritualem in traditione christiana. Katarzyna est nomen femininum quod in variis formis et linguis in usu est.

in_english.name: Katarzyna
in_english.long_meaning: The name Katarzyna originates from the Greek name Καθαρίνη (Katharina), meaning pure and righteous. It is a Christian name that symbolizes spiritual purity and righteousness in Christ. The name has been used in various forms across different cultures and languages, and is associated with several saints and martyrs in Christian tradition. Katarzyna is a popular name among Christians, reflecting the values of purity, justice, and devotion to God.

data.cultural_impact: Katarzyna is a popular name in Poland with a rich cultural heritage. Saint Catherine of Alexandria is one of the most venerated saints in the Polish Catholic Church. Her life story and miracles have been the subjects of various artworks, including paintings, sculptures, and literature. Polish cities and towns, as well as schools and churches, are named after her. In Poland, this name evokes a sense of history, tradition, and faith.
data.spiritual_significance: Katarzyna means 'pure' or 'clean', reflecting the spiritual significance of the name in Christianity. Saint Catherine was a renowned virgin and martyr, whose faith and purity inspired many. The name is deeply connected to the religious belief in the power of a pure soul. Therefore, for those who bear this name, it is a constant reminder of the importance of living a virtuous life, filled with faith and devotion. Additionally, the name Katarzyna symbolizes the Christian virtue of purity of heart and the spiritual journey towards self-improvement and holiness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Katarzyna, meaning "pure one" in Polish, represents the inner purity and grace of a soul chosen by God. It is a reminder of the transformative power of faith, inspiring one to live a virtuous life in accordance with God's will.
